get.summary: read a Worker's heartbeat history (admin only)
get.description: Returns the worker's heartbeat history within `range` (`1h`, `6h`, `24h`, `3d`, `7d`; anything else falls back to `24h`), oldest first — used to plot hardware-usage history. Admin only. Heartbeats are recorded every ~15s, so the rows are averaged into time buckets sized by the range (1min for `1h` up to 2h for `7d`): each item is one bucket, and `createdAt` is the timestamp of its first heartbeat.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Time window of heartbeats to return. Defaults to 7 days.
